Ps={'1':np.ones_like(P),'P':P,'P2':P**2,'P3':P**3}
names=[];cols=[]

    for pn,pp in Ps.items():
        names.append(pn+'*'+gn); cols.append(pp*g)

G=X.T@X; b=X.T@y; yy=y@y
def err(S):
    S=list(S)
    try:
        c=np.linalg.solve(G[np.ix_(S,S)]+1e-12*np.eye(len(S)),b[S])
    except Exception: return 1e9,None
    r=yy-2*c@b[S]+c@G[np.ix_(S,S)]@c
    return r/ (yy-len(y)*(y.mean())**2), c

import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    g1 = t/(1+t)
    g2 = np.exp(-0.3*t)
    g3 = np.exp(-0.6*t)
    g4 = t
    g5 = np.sqrt(t)
    g6 = 1/(1+t)**2
    g7 = 1/(1+t)
    return (params[0]*g1 + params[1]*P**3*g2 + params[2]*g3 + params[3]*P**3*g4
            + params[4]*P*g5 + params[5]*g6 + params[6]*P**2*g7)
